limitations: Differential qualification uses InjOffice-owned corpus predicates and does not import a third-party Office runtime.

The pinned DOCX office-export is Microsoft Macintosh Word numbering evidence. A Microsoft Macintosh PowerPoint 16 CC-BY-4.0 fixture is in-repo but absent from this v1 baseline pin, so it is not a v1 office-export record. No XLSX differential is claimed.
Corpus cases prove exact native predicates, not screenshot authority.
Go allocation ceilings and deterministic Node work counters are gates; wall-clock, heap, and RSS samples are report-only.
Compact pinned fixtures qualify bounded native algorithms and are not throughput claims for large customer documents.
No Microsoft Office, LibreOffice, browser, Mammoth, third-party office-suite runtime, external renderer, network service, or secret participates.
